analysis: Both units are head-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (documentation only, mode 100644 unchanged); no executable code, configuration, or trust logic changes. The visible entries describe App Attest/TB-011 behaviors (CandidateCDHash binding, first-grant recovery, revocation fencing, Apple API retry), the T-041 SSD prefix cache (encrypted checkpoints, per-model default enablement, disk budget), account-scoped SLA, and privacy-description changes. They are consistent with the canonical model: serving authorization still requires fresh assertion, qualified build, nonrevoked key and connection binding; missing evidence never grants. One minor observation: the changelog line at ~387 says private-only providers are excluded from the public attestation roster, consistent with the model header. Another changelog statement about the T-041 text claims deletion of retired kv/ files through v0.9.10, which cannot be verified here and is not a regression. No new attack surface or invalidated assumptions are evident from changelog text alone. Source implementations of the described changes are not included in this batch, so the described behaviors were not verified. Later passes should check the actual code changes (coordinator/appattest, SSD cache policy, TTL 30m) if supplied, since the changelog cannot substantiate the security conclusions.
